emulator_sequence.staging: The current disposable world has one inferred Forean Warrior placement 198691 and six Thrax placements 198660-198665. Creature-hit tracing shows all six attack that Warrior on MapLoaded; its health reaches zero before any staged Thrax dies in the runs below. The Warrior's field-level provenance is docs/evidence/bootcamp-courtyard-forean-warrior.json.

assessment.finding: In four current emulator runs, the only staged Warrior dies before the first staged Thrax. The final-week recording instead shows a targetable Forean Warrior after three kill reward events in the visible courtyard fight (391.533, 396.133 and 401.533 seconds). This establishes a sequence conflict for the tested runs, not an impossibility proof for every player action. The footage does not identify whether the original actor was the same Warrior from the start, a later arrival or a different faction. The exact live map-load time is hidden by the camp-to-courtyard edit, so the 7-8 second emulator survival time cannot be compared directly with the 16.4 seconds of visible courtyard footage.
assessment.action: Keep the mismatch and source limits explicit. Do not invent a timer, extra defender, altered damage value or Warrior replacement from this comparison alone. Seek direct final-live footage or original server data for activation and actor count; continue independently verified boot-camp work.
